rundown: Cyclones beat Bearcats 41-13 at Jack Trice Stadium in Ames, IA. Cyclones led 31-13 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Cyclones won it 21-7.
Scoring: Bearcats 2 touchdowns and 0 field goals; Cyclones 4 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: Ar. Barnes III run for 32 yds, for a TD (K. Konrardy KICK) (4th quarter, 1:40).

Leading the way — Bearcats: JC French IV 14/23, 97 yds, 1 TD; Cole Tabb 16 car, 165 yds, 8 rec, 70 yds. Cyclones: Jaylen Raynor 14/23, 229 yds, 1 TD, 1 INT; Aiden Flora 28 car, 216 yds, 3 TD; Cameron Pettaway 2 rec, 76 yds, 1 TD.
Where Cyclones won it: they outgained them 551 yards to 401, won the turnover battle (1 to 2) and held the ball 32:22 to 27:38.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Cyclones closed as 2.5-point favorites and covered by 25.5; the total closed at 57.5 and they combined for 54, under by 3.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 11:57 AM ET. It had Bearcats 49% and Cyclones 51%, projecting Bearcats 28 – Cyclones 28.5 (56.6 total, Cyclones by 0.5).

Final: Bearcats 13 – Cyclones 41. Right winner: it had Cyclones at 51%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bearcats came in with a 8% above average attack and a 6% stingier than average defense (5-4, 33 scored and 29.4 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 172 and 176 games of evidence. Projected to score 28, they scored 13 (−15 points, 54% under); projected to allow 28.5, they allowed 41 (+12.5 points, 44% over).

Cyclones came in with a 5% above average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (4-5, 29.2 scored and 28.9 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 170 and 176 games of evidence. Projected to score 28.5, they scored 41 (+12.5 points, 44% over); projected to allow 28, they allowed 13 (−15 points, 54% under).

The bigger miss was Bearcats' scoring (-15 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 54 against 56.6 projected (-2.6), about the 43rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Cyclones by 28 against Cyclones by 0.5 projected, about the 96th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
ISU ML (-130) at -130: the algo gave it 54% vs 54% fair (-0.3 pts) — won (+0.8u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 54%). CIN ML (+110) at +110: the algo gave it 46% vs 46% fair (+0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 46%). ISU -2.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.6 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. CIN +2.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 57.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (-0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 57.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (+0.4 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 49% of bets on Bearcats, 47% of the money — Cyclones covered; total: 52% of bets on the over, 63% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 18% of bets on Bearcats, 20% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Cyclones, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.919 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +26 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 73 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.962 and gives home teams -1.5 points. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 27.5 points), no bet.
